newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Telebras pushes Brazil shrs to higher end.
newsitem.headline: Telebras pushes Brazil shrs to higher end.

text.p: After falling for five straight sessions, Brazilian stocks ended strong as benchmark Telebras surged 3.79 percent to 76.60 reais, helped by fresh export data which diminished concerns over the country's trade gap, brokers said.

The Bovespa index .BVSP of the 49 most traded shares rose 2.32 percent to 65,498 points. Market volume also increased sharply to 599.1 million reais ($583 million), with Telebras shares and options accounting for over 70 percent of the bolsa's trade.
